readerCopy.headline: One more yes can take the rest of the day with it.
readerCopy.body:
A family request, guest, home expense, or emotional promise can look small while you are agreeing to it and take much more time once it arrives. You want to help. You may even have the money or the afternoon. The problem is what that yes pushes into tomorrow.

Jupiter square Moon makes generosity easy before the logistics are clear. Find out what the help actually requires before you become the default person handling it. One afternoon is one afternoon. Something that happens every week is a different agreement.
